angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,085,292 km at 245.40 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.0750 +/- 0.0186 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12): 245.40 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.56 +/- 0.08 solar radii from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar radius of HAT-P-13 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract): 1,085,292 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.22 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar mass of HAT-P-13 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5653 +/- 90 K from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-13 b's parameter set from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.530.2475Y/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Yalçınkaya et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-13 b's parameter set from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.530.2475Y/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-13.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.138, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-13 (pscomppars): spectral type G4, from Bakos et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...707..446B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HAT-P-13: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-13 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.46 dex, from Knutson et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...785..126K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-13 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.346, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-13 (pscomppars): age 5 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-13 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.66 km/s, from Winn et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010ApJ...718..575W/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
